_comment: ARKive Official Manuals source list. tools/fetch_manuals.py downloads 'fetch' entries into <dest>/<subject>/ and writes manifest.json. Only US Government works (public domain) from official sites, or archive.org copies of public-domain military manuals. Anything marked distribution-restricted / FOUO / CUI is refused.
license: US Government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105)

items.subject: Survival
items.title: Multi-Service TTP for Survival, Evasion, and Recovery
items.note: All APD/ALSA editions after 1999 (FM 3-50.3 2007, ATP 3-50.3 2012/2023) are distribution-restricted (2012: Statement D, DoD and contractors only); the public 1999 FM 21-76-1 is included instead

items.note: Last public-release edition of the multi-service SERE manual. Cover: 'Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.' Also present in the Survival Guides library.
